claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLOv2 achieves 76.8 mAP on VOC 2007 at 67 FPS.
claims.evidence_quote_short: At 67 FPS, YOLOv2 gets 76.8 mAP on VOC 2007.

claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLOv2 outperforms Faster R-CNN with ResNet and SSD while running significantly faster.
claims.evidence_quote_short: outperforming state-of-the-art methods like Faster R-CNN with ResNet and SSD while still running significantly faster.

claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLO9000 can detect over 9000 object categories in real-time.
claims.evidence_quote_short: YOLO9000, a real-time object detector that can detect over 9000 different object categories.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Adding batch normalization to YOLO improves mAP by more than 2%.
claims.evidence_quote_short: By adding batch normalization on all of the convolutional layers in YOLO we get more than 2% improvement in mAP.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Using anchor boxes with YOLO decreases accuracy slightly but increases recall.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Using anchor boxes we get a small decrease in accuracy. ... With anchor boxes our model gets69.2 mAP with a recall of 88%.

claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLO9000 achieves 19.7 mAP on the ImageNet detection validation set with only partial detection data.
claims.evidence_quote_short: YOLO9000 gets 19.7 mAP on the ImageNet detection validation set despite only having detection data for 44 of the 200 classes.

claims.claim_text_normalized: The original YOLO suffers from a significant number of localization errors and low recall.
claims.evidence_quote_short: YOLO makes a significant number of localization errors. Furthermore, YOLO has relatively low recall compared to region proposal-based methods.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Darknet-19 requires only 5.58 billion operations and achieves 72.9% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Darknet-19 only requires 5.58 billion operations to process an image yet achieves 72.9% top-1 accuracy and 91.2% top-5 accuracy on ImageNet.
